review_requirements: Recover and justify the noninferiority margin, sidedness and interval decision rule.
Define the therapy-delay derivation, zero-event contribution, repeated events and exposure unit.
Require randomized and per-protocol population definitions and concordance for noninferiority.
Replace the ambiguous Kaplan-Meier, count and rank-sum choices with estimand-aligned methods.
Resolve informative early exit, missing endpoint data, multiplicity and sample-size reproducibility.
Verify every evidence excerpt against the rendered one-based physical PDF page.
